description: Source code for a firmware header generator tool, creating firmware images with specific headers for Meraki Z1 Access Point, including checksum calculation and command-line interface.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board info structure by its ID from a predefined list.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the command-line tool.

methods.name: writel
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value into a buffer at a specified offset in network byte order.

methods.name: crc32_csum
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a buffer and writes it into the buffer.

methods.name: meraki_build_hdr
methods.description: Builds a firmware header with checksum and writes it to output file.
